description: Structural changes and interactive JS features — gallery horizontal carousel with scroll-snap and progress bar, venue arch card shape with floral decoration, SKIP button on envelope, Share button in closing, decorative family separator, family quote card, staggered entrance animations via upgraded IntersectionObserver, active section highlighting on bottom nav. All 9 items require HTML additions and/or JS modules. Depends on FEAT-001 being committed first (so CSS animation keyframes exist), but the HTML/JS changes do not conflict with FEAT-001's CSS modifications.
steps: 1. GALLERY CAROUSEL (item 1) — HTML: In index.html, rename the `.i-gallery__grid` div to `.i-gallery__carousel` (change the class). Keep all 4 `

2. VENUE ARCH (item 3) — CSS: Change `.i-venue__map` border-radius from `16px` to `168px 168px 0 0`. This creates the arch/mandap doorway shape. Increase padding-top on `.i-venue__map-inner` from `3rem` to `4rem` so content doesn't crowd the top of the arch. Add a decorative floral element at the arch crown: `.i-venue__map::before { content:''; position:absolute; top:-8px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); width:60px; height:30px; background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,..."); background-size:contain; background-repeat:no-repeat; z-index:1; }` where the SVG data URI is a small gold floral motif (paisley or lotus). Alternative: add an inline SVG element in index.html inside `.i-venue__map` positioned absolutely at the top. Make sure `.i-venue__map` has `position:relative` (it may already for the pseudo). Add `overflow:visible` to `.i-venue__map` so the floral element can peek above the arch.

3. SKIP BUTTON (item 9) — HTML: In index.html, add `<button class="envelope-cover__skip" id="envelope-skip">SKIP</button>` as the first child of `.envelope-cover__inner`. CSS: `.envelope-cover__skip { position:absolute; top:1.5rem; right:1.5rem; z-index:10; background:none; border:none; font-family:var(--f-serif); font-weight:500; font-size:0.7rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.15em; color:var(--i-ink-soft); opacity:0.5; cursor:pointer; -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent; transition:opacity 0.2s; } .envelope-cover__skip:hover { opacity:0.8; }`. JS: In the `initEnvelope()` function in js/script.js, after defining `openEnvelope`, add: `var skipBtn = document.getElementById('envelope-skip'); if (skipBtn) { skipBtn.addEventListener('click', openEnvelope); }`.

4. SHARE BUTTON (item 11) — HTML: In index.html, inside `.i-closing__content`, add before the `.i-closing__made` paragraph: `<button class="i-closing__share reveal" id="share-btn" style="--reveal-offset:0.45s"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12v8a2 2 0 002 2h12a2 2 0 002-2v-8" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/><polyline points="16 6 12 2 8 6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><line x1="12" y1="2" x2="12" y2="15" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg> Share this invitation</button>`. CSS: `.i-closing__share { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem; background:none; border:1px solid var(--i-gold); color:var(--i-on-stage); font-family:var(--f-serif); font-weight:400; font-size:0.85rem; padding:0.6rem 1.5rem; border-radius:24px; cursor:pointer; transition:opacity 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; margin-bottom:1.5rem; } .i-closing__share:hover { opacity:0.8; }`. JS: Add `initShareButton()` function using `navigator.share({title:'Mukul weds Sailly', text:'You are invited to our wedding!', url:window.location.href})` with fallback to `navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href)` showing 'Link copied!' for 2s. Call from DOMContentLoaded.

5. FAMILY SEPARATOR (item 13) — HTML: In index.html, between the two `.i-family__card` divs inside `.i-family__cards`, insert: `
`. CSS: `.i-family__separator { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0.5rem 0; opacity:0.7; }`. On tablet (768px+ where cards go side-by-side), the separator should sit between them: `.i-family__cards` is already a flex column, going to flex row at 768px. The separator needs `align-self:center` for the row layout. Add `@media (min-width:768px) { .i-family__separator { padding:0 0.5rem; } }` so it works horizontally too. Ensure `flex-shrink:0` so it doesn't collapse.

6. FAMILY QUOTE CARD (item 19) — HTML: In index.html, after `.i-family__roles` div and before `.i-family__close` paragraph, add: `
"We can't wait to dance at the wedding!"
— The cousins
`. CSS: `.i-family__quote { max-width:400px; margin:1.5rem auto; text-align:center; background:var(--i-card); padding:1.5rem 2rem; border-radius:8px; transform:rotate(-1.5deg); box-shadow: rgba(61,36,32,0.05) 0 1px 2px, rgba(61,36,32,0.1) 0 6px 12px -4px; }` `.i-family__quote blockquote { font-family:var(--f-hand); font-weight:400; font-size:clamp(1rem,2.5vw,1.15rem); color:var(--i-ink-soft); line-height:1.5; margin:0; }` `.i-family__quote cite { display:block; font-family:var(--f-serif); font-style:italic; font-size:0.8rem; color:var(--i-gold); margin-top:0.5rem; }`.

7. STAGGERED ENTRANCE ANIMATIONS (item 7) — JS: In js/script.js, modify the `initScrollReveal()` function. The current observer adds `.is-visible` to each `.reveal` element individually. Upgrade: When a `.reveal` element becomes visible AND it has child elements that also have class `.reveal`, add staggered `transitionDelay` to those children. Updated observer callback: `if (entry.isIntersecting) { entry.target.classList.add('is-visible'); var children = entry.target.querySelectorAll('.reveal'); children.forEach(function(child, i) { child.style.transitionDelay = ((i + 1) * 0.1) + 's'; requestAnimationFrame(function() { child.classList.add('is-visible'); }); }); observer.unobserve(entry.target); }`. CSS: Update `.reveal` base style: change `transform: translateY(var(--reveal-y, 24px))` to `transform: translateY(30px)` and change `transition` to use `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` easing instead of the current `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`. Keep the existing `--reveal-offset` support for top-level elements. NOTE: Be careful not to double-observe children that are already being observed individually — the children inside a parent `.reveal` should only get staggered if they are nested `.reveal` elements. The observer should skip re-observing children that will be staggered by their parent.

8. ACTIVE NAV HIGHLIGHTING (item 15) — JS: Add `initNavHighlight()` function in js/script.js. Create a new IntersectionObserver with `threshold:0.3` watching sections: `document.querySelectorAll('section[id]')`. In the callback, find the section that is most in view and add `.is-active` to the matching bottom-nav item (match via `a[href="#" + section.id]`), remove `.is-active` from others. Skip the accent RSVP item from receiving the underline style. CSS: `.bottom-nav__item.is-active:not(.bottom-nav__item--accent) { color: var(--i-gold); } .bottom-nav__item.is-active:not(.bottom-nav__item--accent)::after { content:''; display:block; width:16px; height:2px; background:var(--i-gold); margin:2px auto 0; border-radius:1px; }`. Call `initNavHighlight()` from DOMContentLoaded handler.
acceptance_criteria: Gallery section displays as a horizontal carousel: items scroll left/right with snap-to-center behavior. Each placeholder has a gold photo-frame border. A thin gold progress bar beneath the carousel updates as user scrolls.
Venue card has a distinctive arch shape (wide rounded top corners ~168px) with a decorative floral element at the crown.
A 'SKIP' button appears at the top-right of the envelope cover. Clicking it opens the envelope using the same animation as tapping the seal.
A 'Share this invitation' button with a share icon appears in the closing section. On click it triggers Web Share API (mobile) or copies the URL to clipboard with feedback text.
A decorative gold heart/flourish ornament appears between the two family cards as a visual separator.
A tilted quote card with handwritten font ('We can't wait to dance at the wedding!' — The cousins) appears in the family section after the roles.
When scrolling to a section, child elements with `.reveal` stagger in one-by-one at ~0.1s intervals, not all at once.
The bottom nav highlights the current section with a gold underline/text color as user scrolls through the page.
Existing functionality is preserved: envelope seal click, scratch hearts, countdown timer, RSVP WhatsApp form, music toggle, bottom nav links, smooth scroll.
verification: Serve the site with `python3 -m http.server 8765` and verify each new feature visually. Use Playwright if available to test the gallery carousel scroll, skip button click, share button click, and nav highlighting.
findings: All 8 steps implemented. (1) Gallery: converted 2x2 grid to horizontal scroll-snap carousel with progress bar; removed all responsive grid overrides at 768px/1024px; added gold photo-frame border (3px solid gold + inset box-shadow). (2) Venue arch: border-radius changed to 168px 168px 0 0, overflow:visible, padding-top increased to 4rem, decorative gold lotus SVG ::before at arch crown. (3) SKIP button added as first child of envelope-cover__inner, wired to same openEnvelope function. (4) Share button with share icon SVG added in closing section; JS uses navigator.share() with clipboard.writeText fallback. (5) Gold heart SVG separator inserted between the two family cards with responsive horizontal padding at 768px. (6) Tilted quote card with Kalam font added after family roles. (7) initScrollReveal upgraded: only top-level .reveal elements are observed; nested .reveal children receive staggered transitionDelay at 0.1s intervals; easing updated to cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); transform base changed to translateY(30px). (8) initNavHighlight added with IntersectionObserver threshold:0.3 on section[id] elements; gold underline/color on active bottom-nav item (accent item excluded). All new functions registered in DOMContentLoaded. node --check passes. No personal info changed.
